errata: Read aliases normalize explicitly and conflicting aliases reject the record.
Code 6 is documented in prose for HVAC and ERV modes, despite missing enum entries.
ERV speed-value schemas incorrectly say integer; only a valid array authorizes writes.
Legacy angle code 4 is readable but never an allowed write.
DHW temperatures have no implicit unit; writes require an explicit units value.
power uses the ambiguous reported kW/h unit; consumption_ue has no proven unit. Neither is a billing energy counter.
Example-only fields are read-only; erv_power is not a documented command.
Schema hp_configuration quote typo has an explicit alias.
The energy_data object is flattened into its 17 documented optional leaves.
Null and missing fields are unavailable, never synthesized as zero.
Zone humidity 0 is ambiguous in the specification: it is exposed as humidity_reported diagnostic, not an ambient humidity measurement.
Only cloud_connected accepts documented string booleans 0/1; command flags remain strictly typed.
API version accepts the documented schema key as a read alias; conflicting version/schema values reject the record.
